texte.Protection des systèmes d'information co: Protection of information systems against malicious code
texte.Prévention technique des sorties d'ident: Technical prevention of unreviewed identification outputs
texte.Prévoir, dans la stratégie de sortie de: Provide, in the exit strategy of article #, paragraph #, point (f), for what such a publication triggers.
texte.Puisque vous ne mettez pas en œuvre les: Since you do not implement real-time notifications, do the instructions give the thresholds, what the alert must say, on which channel, and through which technical socket the deployer plugs in — enough for them to implement AND TEST without calling you back?
texte.Périodiquement, en cas de changement de: Periodically, where the lead overseer changes or a significant change occurs, the members' performance is assessed and the composition may be changed.
texte.Que vous êtes certifié. Un organisme acc: That you are certified. An accredited body conducts the audit, and it alone issues the certificate.
texte.Que vous êtes en conformité. L'autorité: That you are compliant. The supervisory authority assesses, on the record, and its scope goes beyond what a questionnaire covers.
texte.Quelles exigences réglementaires s'appli: Which regulatory requirements apply, over what scope, under what strategy — and what gets documented about it.
texte.Quelqu'un répond, et on peut savoir de q: Someone answers, and what for can be known.
texte.Qui a le droit de faire quoi, depuis qua: Who is allowed to do what, since when, and until when — the heaviest objective in the framework.
texte.Qui regarde le système, et avec quels an: Who watches the system, and with which blind spots.
Who answers, and for what exactly.
texte.Qui signale, à qui, dans quel délai, ave: Who reports, to whom, within what deadline, with which documents.
texte.RIEN DIRECTEMENT — le texte n'est pas di: NOTHING DIRECTLY — the text is not available here. This module targets that catalogue and bears its name, but has read none of its pages: the families come from SP #-# Rev. #. That is why nothing is measured at control level.
texte.Rapport sur le réexamen du cadre de gest: Report on the review of the ICT risk management framework
texte.Rapport sur le réexamen du cadre simplif: Report on the review of the simplified ICT risk management framework
texte.ReCyF en pratique — collection de fiches: ReCyF in practice — ANSSI factsheet collection, version #
texte.Recensement des principales dépendances: Inventory of the main dependencies on ICT third-party service providers
texte.Redevance annuelle = coûts annuels totau: Annual fee = the overseers' estimated total annual costs, multiplied by a turnover coefficient: the provider's applicable turnover for n−#, over that of ALL critical providers for n−#.
Looked at, and not in place.
texte.Registre de noms de domaine de premier n: A top-level domain name registry or DNS service provider
texte.Rejeter une sortie que le système rejoue: Rejecting an output that the system replays a second later is not a rejection. Stability after rejection is half the function.
texte.Relations avec les tiers et avec les cli: Relations with third parties and with clients
texte.Renoncer à l'activité qui l'engendre. C': Give up the activity that produces it. It is the only option that really removes the risk, and the only one that costs a business decision.
texte.Respect des conditions et du risque rési: Compliance with the conditions and the residual risk
texte.Ressources humaines, contrôle d'accès, g: Human resources, access control, asset management
texte.Retenue par une personne et inscrite au: Adopted by a person and entered in the register
texte.Revoyez-vous les scénarios, les délais e: Do you review the scenarios, the deadlines and the measures during post-market monitoring and at every design change, and update the file accordingly?
texte.Rien dans la norme n'y répond. L'exigenc: Nothing in the standard answers it. The requirement has to be built from scratch.
texte.Rien en place, ou rien qu'on puisse mont: Nothing in place, or nothing that can be shown.
Nothing is in place for this objective.
texte.Rien ne distingue, dans une invite, la c: Nothing in a prompt tells the instruction apart from the data. It is a property of the method: no patch will make it go away, and everything built here is mitigation.
texte.Rien ne s'y saisit : il se marque lu, et: Nothing is entered here: it gets marked read, and “read” is not green.
texte.Rien ne se saisit ici : les huit champs: Nothing is entered here: the eight fields are filled in on the system's record, in the Register. A system with no declared volume does not cost zero — nobody has yet said what it consumes.
texte.Rien ne se saisit ici non plus : le volu: Nothing is entered here either: the volume comes from the system's record, in the Register.
texte.Rien à remplir sur cet écran : il expliq: Nothing to fill in on this screen: it explains. It is marked read because you said so — it is not a validated block.
texte.Rien à écarter : NIS # ne vise pas cette: Nothing to set aside: NIS # does not cover this entity
texte.Rouvrir https://top#.owasp.org/#/ depuis: Reopen https://top#.owasp.org/#/ from an ordinary workstation and confirm the ten titles before showing this view to a client.
texte.Règlement (UE) #/# du Parlement européen: Regulation (EU) #/# of the European Parliament and of the Council of # December # on digital operational resilience for the financial sector
Regulation (EU) #/# of the European Parliament and of the Council of # October # on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
texte.Règlement (UE) #/#, article # — système: Regulation (EU) #/#, article # — quality management system of the provider of a high-risk AI system
texte.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# de la Commiss: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# of # March # supplementing Regulation (EU) #/# with regulatory technical standards specifying ICT risk management tools, methods, processes and policies and the simplified ICT risk management framework
texte.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# — contenu de: Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# — content of the policy on contractual arrangements for ICT services supporting critical or important functions
texte.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# — contenu et: Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# — content and deadlines of the initial notification and of the intermediate and final reports
texte.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# — critères de: Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# — classification criteria and materiality thresholds
texte.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# — éléments à: Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# — elements to determine and assess where ICT services supporting critical functions are subcontracted
texte.Réclamer par écrit sert deux fois : à ob: Asking in writing serves twice: to obtain the information, and to show later that you asked for it.
texte.Réduction au minimum de l'incidence du r: Minimisation of the impact of risk, through sound, resilient and up-to-date systems, protocols and tools
texte.Réexamen au moins tous les trois ans: Review at least every three years
texte.Réservé aux entités essentielles : pour: Reserved for essential entities: for an important one, the block is not applicable, not at zero.
texte.Résiliation du contrat entre l'entité fi: Termination of the contract between the financial entity and the third-party provider
texte.Réutilisation autorisée — décision #/#/U: Reuse authorised — decision #/#/EU, with attribution. Only the text published in the Official Journal prevails.
texte.Révision # : ce n'est plus le dernier mi: Revision #: this is no longer the latest edition of the catalogue.
texte.SP #-# Rev. # surcharge la révision # du: SP #-# Rev. # overlays revision # of the #-# catalogue. It was superseded in # by revision #, which speaks of OT rather than ICS and attaches to revision #. This module measures what revision # requires, because that is the one present here: a reader working on revision # must know this before reading that rate.
texte.SP #-# ne se certifie pas : aucun organi: SP #-# cannot be certified: no body issues an attestation against this catalogue.
texte.Sait-on quels changements déclenchent un: Is it known which changes trigger a regulatory action — new assessment, new documentation, notification?
texte.Sans deux réviseurs indépendants effecti: Without two independent reviewers actually assigned, paragraph #(#) is not held in your organisation: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sans délai de réaction, le choix des cat: With no reaction time, the choice of measure categories is justifiable by nothing: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sans filtrage par scénario, type de sort: Without filtering by scenario, output type and confidence score, a retrospective review over a large volume becomes random browsing.
texte.Sans fonction d'intervention, la supervi: With no intervention function, human oversight can prevent nothing: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sans le socle #-# renseigné, chaque axe: Without the #-# baseline filled in, every axis is capped at zero: fill in the catalogue screen first.
texte.Sans mise en œuvre des mesures que la no: Without implementing the measures the instructions assign to you, human oversight of the system you operate does not exist: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sans prévention technique des sorties no: Without technical prevention of unreviewed outputs, paragraph #(#) is not held on a remote biometric identification system: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sans retard injustifié — aucun délai chi: Without undue delay — no figure given, which does not make it a soft obligation: “without undue delay” is judged after the fact, against what could have been done.
texte.Sans scénario de risque identifié, aucun: With no identified risk scenario, no oversight measure is calibrated against anything: the score cannot exceed # %.
texte.Sauvegardes éprouvées et reprise mesurée: Tested backups and measured recovery: what makes it possible to keep serving when the main system stops responding.
texte.Savoir ce que l'auditeur ouvre en premie: Knowing what the auditor opens first avoids preparing stage # before stage #.
texte.Savoir de qui l'on dépend — fournisseurs: Knowing who you depend on — suppliers, providers, subsidiaries — and what each one can reach.
texte.Savoir où l'on va avant de remplir le re: Knowing where you are going before filling in the register.
texte.Savoir quels systèmes sont concernés ava: Knowing which systems are concerned before auditing.
texte.Scans de sécurité fondés sur des critère: Security scans based on risk assessment criteria
texte.Schéma européen de certification de cybe: European cybersecurity certification scheme (assurance level at least “substantial”)
texte.Se déduit de la formule « dispositions p: Follows from the words “relevant provisions” in article #, paragraph #; the Commission's guidelines set its scope.
texte.Se faire regarder par quelqu'un d'autre,: Being looked at by somebody else, at a defined interval, and handling what comes out of it.
texte.Sensibilisation des personnes désignées: Automation bias awareness for the designated persons
texte.Service essentiel interrompu, tiers affe: Essential service interrupted, third parties affected, notification obligation possible.
texte.Seul prestataire, dans un État membre, d: The sole provider in a Member State of a service essential for the maintenance of critical societal or economic activities
texte.Seulement sur les systèmes d'information: Only on the information systems COVERED BY THE CERTIFICATION. A narrow certification scope covers only part of the objective — the rest remains to be demonstrated.
texte.Si les mesures d'exécution restent ineff: If the enforcement measures remain ineffective, the authority may have a certification or an authorisation suspended, and have the chief executive officer or legal representative TEMPORARILY BARRED from exercising managerial responsibilities in the entity.
texte.Sont-ils surveillés et ré-évalués en cou: Are they monitored and reassessed over their life?
texte.Spécifications relatives aux notificatio: Specifications for the notifications implemented by the deployer
texte.Stratégie commerciale future — changemen: Future business strategy — group or management changes, new markets, new activities
texte.Stratégie de sortie : période de transit: Exit strategy: a mandatory transition period during which the service continues, allowing migration elsewhere or reinsourcing
texte.Structure d'entreprise — société mère et: Corporate structure — parent company and related undertakings providing ICT services to Union financial entities
texte.Suivi des recommandations de l'article #: Follow-up of the recommendations of article #, paragraph #, point (d)
texte.Supervision effective — travaux de l'équ: Effective oversight — work of the joint examination team and advice of the independent experts
texte.Supervisé depuis le #er janvier : au plu: Under oversight since # January: by # April of the same year at the latest.
texte.Support d'interprétation de sortie pour: Output interpretation support for the designated persons
texte.Surveillance après commercialisation et: Post-market monitoring and serious incidents — the two obligations an authority takes up without waiting for an audit, and the second chapter with no ISO equivalent.
texte.Surveillance permanente de la sécurité e: Continuous monitoring of the security and functioning of all ICT systems
texte.Survient plusieurs fois par an, ou une v: Occurs several times a year, or an exploitable vulnerability is already known.
texte.Système de management de la qualité pour: Quality management system for EU AI Act regulatory purposes
texte.Sécurisation de l'architecture des systè: Securing the architecture of information systems
texte.Sécurisation de la configuration des res: Securing the configuration of information system resources
texte.Sécurisation des accès distants aux syst: Securing remote access to information systems
texte.Tenu, ET démontrable devant un tiers san: Held, AND demonstrable to a third party with no preparation.
texte.Tests réguliers de ces plans et de l'eff: Regular testing of those plans and of the effectiveness of the controls
texte.Tous les champs attendus de ce bloc sont: Every field expected in this block is filled in. That is not compliance — it is the authority that assesses.
texte.Tous les sous-critères de seuil sont att: All the threshold sub-criteria are met. The ESAs then carry out the “step #” assessment, which is not computed: this module states it and does not simulate it.
texte.Toute communication entre les AES et les: All communication between the ESAs and the critical providers takes place electronically.
texte.Toute personne, autre que le fabricant,: Any person, other than the manufacturer, the importer or the distributor, who makes a substantial modification to a product already on the market and makes it available.
texte.Traiter l'arrivée, la mobilité et le dép: Treating arrival, movement and departure as security events, and training those who are exposed.
texte.Traiter, arbitrer, surveiller : affecter: Handle, arbitrate, monitor: allocate the resources, decide what is accepted, prepare the response and the recovery.
texte.Transmettre par les canaux électroniques: Submit through the dedicated secure electronic channels indicated by the lead overseer, in the form and structure it defines, clearly locating each item requested.
texte.Transparence et fourniture d'information: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
texte.Trente jours civils à compter de la réce: Thirty calendar days from receipt of the declaration
texte.Trois ans est un PLANCHER, pas une caden: Three years is a FLOOR, not a cadence: an incident reopens the analysis without waiting for the due date.
texte.Un article non déclaré compte pour zéro: An undeclared article counts as zero AND stays in the denominator: silence does not lighten the requirement.
texte.Un axe est plafonné par la plus faible d: An axis is capped by the weakest of the #-# families it tailors.
texte.Un bloc précédent n'est pas complet, et: An earlier block is not complete, and this one depends on it. It will not open until the other is filled in.
